title: Poisson structures for a similarity reduction of the Drinfeld-Sokolov hierarchy of type $A$
summary: In this article we consider the Drinfeld-Sokolov hierarchy of type $A$ and its similarity reduction. Then the similarity reduction is expressed as $2$ types of Hamiltonian systems, one is with a Poisson bracket and another a Poisson bracket of canonical coordinates. We also investigate a connection between the similarity reduction and the isomonodromy deformation system.
